summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for VCR-based HTTP interaction recording/replay. It differs semantically from peer HTTP mocking (requests_mock) and filesystem mocking (pyfakefs) by capturing real request/response pairs for reproducibility rather than stubbing at client level. Existing skills address MongoDB migration and Spring routing—no semantic overlap. Candidate has clear workflow, constraints, and cautions; support evidence confirms relevance to test debugging. No merge, split, or revision needed.
